summary: On 2026-10-12 (JST) the complete single file, as it was then, was processed to the end once in the public Lean4Web server project mathlib-stable. The file was regenerated afterwards, when the statement definitions were simplified; the current file has not been run on the server. This is a manual observation in a browser, not a reproducible or archived check.
difference_from_current_file: Lines 1-38925 are identical. The remaining lines, which hold the statement definitions, their identification with bundled channels and the final theorems, were regenerated.

manual_browser_runs.detail: The imported module Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombinationPrime does not exist in that newer Mathlib. No proof was examined.

193 messages had been reported, which equals the number of messages in the local build log up to line 36228 of 39376 (192 warnings and one hint). The first and last ones shown matched that log and none shown was an error. The browser then reported that it had no connection to Lean.

The four final #print axioms commands at lines 39368-39371 each reported [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], and the warnings shown before them match the end of the local build log. The total message count was not captured.

evidence: Screenshots of the browser taken by the author during the runs. They are not stored in this repository.
relation_to_pinned_environment: The pinned Mathlib revision is Mathlib tag v4.34.1, which is tag v4.34.0 plus one commit that changes only lean-toolchain, and all 138 imports of the single file exist at tag v4.34.0. The server project is labelled v4.34.0; its exact Mathlib commit was not inspected.
scope: Server project names and three manual browser runs. The server's projects are not pinned by this repository and are replaced as new releases appear, so a later run may behave differently. The local build and CI remain the reproducible checks.
